schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE corsi (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    descrizione TEXT,
    crediti INT CHECK (crediti > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE studenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_nascita DATE NOT NULL,
    codice_fiscale TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    corso_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES corsi(id)
);

query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totale_studenti, AVG(c.crediti) AS crediti_media, MAX(c.crediti) AS crediti_massimi, MIN(c.crediti) AS crediti_minimi, SUM(c.crediti) AS crediti_totali FROM studenti s JOIN corsi c ON s.corso_id = c.id;
